description: Database tables and columns (final state through migration 0050), foreign keys with ON DELETE behaviour, triggers, and trigger-to-function links.

attrs.purpose: Supabase Auth account store (GoTrue-owned, not created by this repo). The CRM reads email, password state and sign-up metadata, and a trigger creates the matching profile.

columns.name: id
columns.check: PK; parent of 10 FKs: 3 CASCADE (profiles.id, company_members.user_id, project_briefs.created_by), 6 NO ACTION (companies.created_by, contacts.created_by, deals.owner_id, tasks.assigned_to, tasks.created_by, notes.created_by), 1 SET NULL (blog_posts.author_id)

columns.name: email
columns.check: UNVERIFIED column type; GoTrue enforces uniqueness

columns.name: encrypted_password
columns.check: '' on older GoTrue schemas and NULL on newer ones both mean no password set

columns.name: raw_user_meta_data
columns.check: keys read by the CRM: full_name, account_type

columns.name: raw_app_meta_data
columns.check: 'role' key was synced once by 0005 and is not authoritative since 0008

columns.name: created_at
columns.check: read by the notification worker for client context emails

attrs.purpose: Supabase Storage object index. The CRM stores every attachment and deliverable in the private bucket project-files.

columns.name: bucket_id
columns.check: project-files for CRM files (bucket created 0003:106-108, set private 0009:1168-1171)

columns.name: name
columns.check: object key `{project_id}/{row_id}/{safe_file_name}`; policies require exactly 2 folder segments

attrs.purpose: One row per auth user: role, display name, company link and the staff-access request flag. The single source of truth for roles since 0008.

columns.name: id
columns.check: PK; FK auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

columns.name: role
columns.check: profiles_role_allowed_check: role::text IN (client, project_manager, admin); the enum also contains 'staff' (0001:9), which the check rejects

columns.name: company_id
columns.check: no FK (soft reference to companies.id); changes blocked outside validated commands

columns.name: created_at
columns.check: nullable; changes blocked outside validated commands since 0046

columns.name: requested_staff_access
columns.check: request flag only; confers no privilege

attrs.purpose: A client or lead organisation. Created by admins, by client onboarding and by the contact-form lead RPC.

columns.name: email
columns.check: no unique; a copy of an email at creation time, never re-synced

attrs.purpose: A person at a company: sales contacts, website leads and the onboarded client user.

columns.name: last_name
columns.check: '' is written for onboarding and single-word lead names

columns.name: email
columns.check: nullable since 0008:5-6; UNIQUE on lower(email) WHERE email IS NOT NULL, across all companies (contacts_lower_email_unique_idx)

columns.name: status
columns.check: no check; the admin forms offer lead, prospect, customer, inactive; onboarding writes 'client'

attrs.purpose: Sales pipeline record. Created by admins and by the contact-form lead RPC. project_status and the project link are legacy.

columns.name: contact_id
columns.check: FK contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: stage
columns.check: no check. App vocabulary: prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, closed_won, closed_lost

columns.name: project_status
columns.check: deals_project_status_check IN (brief_submitted, in_progress, in_review, delivered). LEGACY: nothing writes or reads it after 0003

columns.name: project_type
columns.check: deals_project_type_check IN (logo, web, seo, smm, ai_automation, google_ads, branding); NULL passes

attrs.purpose: Legacy CRM to-do list attached to a company, deal or contact. Separate from project_tasks.

columns.name: deal_id
columns.check: FK deals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: contact_id
columns.check: FK contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: status
columns.check: no check. Forms offer todo, in_progress, review, done, blocked; legacy rows hold open and completed

columns.name: priority
columns.check: no check; forms offer low, medium, high

columns.name: assigned_to
columns.check: FK auth.users(id) NO ACTION; the admin form always sets the creator

attrs.purpose: Free-text CRM notes on a company or contact. Immutable through the API (no UPDATE policy).

columns.name: contact_id
columns.check: FK contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: deal_id
columns.check: FK deals(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: updated_at
columns.check: stamped by on_notes_updated (no UPDATE policy, so only privileged writers reach it)

columns.name: visibility
columns.check: notes_visibility_check IN ('internal', 'client'); differs from the project tables' 'shared'

attrs.purpose: Second company-membership list, used only by the legacy CRM policies (is_company_member). Written only by client onboarding.

columns.name: role
columns.check: no check; 'owner' is written by onboarding

columns.name: created_at
columns.check: no updated_at and no trigger on this table

attrs.purpose: The project aggregate: one row per client project, with a nine-state status machine driven only by transition_project_status.

columns.name: category
columns.check: projects_category_check IN (web_design, logo_creation, branding, marketing, ai_automation)

columns.name: status
columns.check: projects_status_check: brief_submitted, planned, in_progress, client_review, changes_requested, approved, delivered, on_hold, cancelled

columns.name: updated_at
columns.check: no trigger; only transition_project_status bumps it

columns.name: client_generated_id
columns.check: idempotency key; equals project_briefs.id for brief-created projects

attrs.purpose: The single conversation container of a project. Exists so messages hang off a thread id instead of the project id.

columns.name: project_id
columns.check: UNIQUE; FK projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE (1:1)

attrs.purpose: Which staff are assigned to which project. Drives staff access, the lead project manager and notification recipients.

columns.name: user_id
columns.check: FK profiles(id) NO ACTION; role checked only when assigned (project_manager or admin)

columns.name: assigned_by
columns.check: FK profiles(id) NO ACTION; overwritten on re-assignment

columns.name: created_at
columns.check: the earliest created_at per project defines the lead; kept on re-assignment

attrs.purpose: Chat messages in a project thread, with shared or internal visibility. Edits are in place; there is no delete.

columns.name: thread_id
columns.check: FK project_threads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE. There is no project_id column: the project is reached through the thread

columns.name: visibility
columns.check: project_messages_visibility_check IN ('shared', 'internal'); immutable (no RPC changes it)

attrs.purpose: Files attached to chat messages, reserved first, uploaded to storage, then finalized and linked to a message.

columns.name: message_id
columns.check: FK project_messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; NULL until the message is posted

columns.name: visibility
columns.check: IN ('shared', 'internal'); must equal the message's visibility when linked

columns.name: mime_type
columns.check: char_length(btrim) 1..255; free text claimed by the uploader

columns.name: size_bytes
columns.check: size_bytes > 0 and <= 52428800 (50 MiB); the app caps uploads at 10 MiB

attrs.purpose: Status timeline of a project. Also stores free-standing project notes, as rows whose from_status equals to_status.

columns.name: from_status
columns.check: NULL or one of the nine project statuses; NULL on the first row; equals to_status on a note row

columns.name: to_status
columns.check: one of the nine project statuses

attrs.purpose: Append-only log of project actions written by the RPCs. No screen reads it.

columns.name: actor_id
columns.check: FK profiles(id) NO ACTION; NOT NULL, so service-role flows (leads, onboarding, cleanup) write no audit row

columns.name: project_id
columns.check: FK projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: company_id
columns.check: FK companies(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; filled only by some RPCs

attrs.purpose: Per-project task list worked by staff, optionally visible to the client.

columns.name: status
columns.check: project_tasks_status_check IN (todo, in_progress, review, done, blocked)

columns.name: assignee_id
columns.check: FK profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; not validated as a project participant

columns.name: updated_at
columns.check: no trigger; set by the RPCs

columns.name: priority
columns.check: project_tasks_priority_check IN (low, medium, high); 'urgent' was removed in 0022

columns.name: client_visible
columns.check: rows that existed in 0019 were backfilled to true; no RPC changes it after creation

columns.name: completed_at
columns.check: NOT maintained: the final update_project_task (0012) omits it, so it is always NULL

attrs.purpose: Files the studio delivers to the client: reserved as draft, uploaded, then published as submitted.

columns.name: description
columns.check: no column check; the create RPC limits it to 10000

columns.name: created_by
columns.check: FK profiles(id) NO ACTION; only the creator may publish

attrs.purpose: Approval requests on a project or one of its deliverables, decided once by staff.

columns.name: deliverable_id
columns.check: FK project_deliverables(id) ON DELETE SET NULL; NULL means project-level (and is client-visible)

columns.name: reviewed_by
columns.check: FK profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: note
columns.check: NULL or <= 2000; the RPCs write '' instead of NULL

attrs.purpose: Queue of email and in-app notifications. SQL RPCs insert rows; the cron route drains email rows; the dashboards list in-app rows.

columns.name: project_id
columns.check: FK projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; NULL for lead.created and client.onboarded

columns.name: user_id
columns.check: FK profiles(id) ON DELETE SET NULL (recipient)

columns.name: payload
columns.check: jsonb_typeof = 'object'; keys per event_type in section 3.3

columns.name: status
columns.check: IN ('pending', 'sent', 'failed'); only email rows ever leave pending

columns.name: available_at
columns.check: earliest time a claim may take the row

columns.name: last_error
columns.check: no column bound; the RPCs truncate to 500

columns.name: lease_id
columns.check: notifications_outbox_lease_window_check: lease_id, lease_acquired_at, lease_expires_at all NULL or all set with expires >= acquired

columns.name: failure_code
columns.check: notifications_outbox_failure_code_check IN (missing_recipient, missing_template, provider_retryable, provider_terminal, lease_conflict, unknown)

attrs.purpose: Blog content for /blog, authored in /admin/blog or upserted as drafts from docs/seo/drafts/blog by a CI script.

columns.name: cover_image_url
columns.check: no check in SQL; the app validator requires https

columns.name: published_at
columns.check: published_at_consistency_check: published <=> NOT NULL, draft <=> NULL; a future value is a scheduled post

columns.name: author_id
columns.check: FK auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

columns.name: category
columns.check: slug format, length 1..40; no writer in the repo

columns.name: tags
columns.check: blog_tags_are_valid(tags): <= 8, unique, slug format, <= 40 chars each; no code sets it, so only the default is ever stored

columns.name: author_name
columns.check: NULL or btrim length 1..80; denormalised display name; no writer in the repo

attrs.purpose: Structured client briefs (logo, website, SEO, PPC): a private draft with autosave, then submitted into a new or existing project.

columns.name: project_id
columns.check: FK projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE; NULL on drafts not yet pointed at a project

columns.name: created_by
columns.check: FK auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE (other project tables reference profiles)

columns.name: answers
columns.check: jsonb_typeof = 'object' and octet_length(answers::text) <= 60000 (the app caps its JSON at 56000 bytes)

columns.name: submitted_at
columns.check: project_briefs_submission_state_check: submitted needs submitted_at and project_id; draft needs submitted_at NULL

attrs.purpose: Durable queue of storage objects whose attachment rows were removed as stale uploads and still need deleting from storage.

columns.name: attachment_id
columns.check: no FK: points at an attachment row that was deleted on purpose

columns.name: next_attempt_at
columns.check: lease and backoff: claim pushes it forward by the lease; failure by 2^attempts minutes capped at 24 h

attrs.effect: INSERTs profiles(id, role = 'client', full_name = raw_user_meta_data->>full_name, requested_staff_access = lower(raw_user_meta_data->>account_type) = 'employee'). The profile insert fires enforce_pinned_admin_trigger, which returns at once for a client.
BLOCKS (42501) when NEW.role = 'admin' and lower(auth.users.email) differs from lower(pinned_admin_email()). Reads auth.users. Does not run when only the auth email changes.

BLOCKS (42501) any change to role, company_id, requested_staff_access or created_at unless current_user is the owner of admin_set_user_role(uuid,text). SECURITY INVOKER, so a SECURITY DEFINER function owned by that role passes; PostgREST sessions (authenticated, service_role) do not.
Sets NEW.updated_at = now(). Notes have no UPDATE policy, so only privileged writers reach it.

BROADCASTS event project_message_created on private topic project:<project_id>:<message visibility> with ids only (message_id, project_id, visibility, created_at). Skipped when auth.uid() is NULL or differs from sender_id, so service-role inserts do not broadcast.
BROADCASTS project_message_updated on project:<project_id>:<message visibility> (message_id, project_id, visibility, edited_at), with the same auth.uid() skip rule.
Sets updated_at = now(); sets published_at = now() when status is published and it is NULL; CLEARS published_at whenever status is draft.
Forces NEW.id = OLD.id and NEW.created_at = OLD.created_at (the id is the project idempotency key) and sets updated_at = now().

When NEW.status differs from OLD.status, BROADCASTS project_status_changed ({project_id}) to BOTH project:<id>:shared and project:<id>:internal. No auth.uid() guard: service-role updates broadcast too. Fires for transitions with internal visibility as well, so clients see the new status while the note stays staff-only. Returns NULL.

BROADCASTS project_task_changed ({project_id, task_id}) to project:<id>:internal always, and to project:<id>:shared only when the task is client_visible (OLD or NEW on update, OLD on delete, NEW on insert). Fires on every UPDATE of any column. No auth.uid() guard.

BROADCASTS project_approval_changed ({project_id, approval_id}) to project:<id>:internal always, and to :shared only when the approval is project-level (deliverable_id NULL) or its deliverable is shared (checked for OLD and NEW). Reads project_deliverables. An UPDATE of an approval that was client-visible sends the shared event twice (the first block because OLD was visible, then the same-project branch again; 0050:145-152 and 0050:171-180). No auth.uid() guard.

edges.notes: INSERTs profiles(id, role = 'client', full_name = raw_user_meta_data->>full_name, requested_staff_access = lower(raw_user_meta_data->>account_type) = 'employee'). The profile insert fires enforce_pinned_admin_trigger, which returns at once for a client.
